description: Bike/Pedestrian Intersection Profile 2015 is a dataset listed in County of San Mateo open data portal (datahub.smcgov.org), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by County of San Mateo. Profile information for the bike and pedestrian count that took place in September, 2015. Bike and pedestrian count data from 2016 can be found in two other datasets: Summary Bike and Pedestrian Count 2016 Site Specific Summary Bike Pedestrian Count 2016. Coverage: San Mateo County, California. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are walking, bicycles, sustainability. The table has 39 columns. Attribution on the portal: Office of Sustainability, County of San Mateo. The portal shows 2016-01-30 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datahub-smcgov-org-portal.
